from collections import Counter

p = input().strip()
a = input().strip()
cp = Counter(p)
ca = Counter(c for c in a if c != '*')
stars = len(a) - sum(ca.values())
ok = all(cp[ch] >= n for ch, n in ca.items()) and sum(min(cp[ch], n) for ch, n in ca.items()) + stars == len(p)
print('S' if ok else 'N')
